scripts.build:cpp: cd build/debug && make -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)
scripts.build:cpp-release: cd build/release && make -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4)
scripts.build:ffi: cd build/debug && make -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4) KellyFFI
scripts.build:plugins: cd build/release && make -j$(nproc 2>/dev/null || sysctl -n hw.ncpu 2>/dev/null || echo 4) KellyPlugin
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:react" "npm run dev:cpp" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:cpp && npm run test:rust && npm run test:integration && npm run test:performance
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:ts
scripts.format: npm run format:rust && npm run format:ts
